bahrain.title: Cabinet condemns continued Iranian attacks on Bahrain
bahrain.summary: At its weekly session chaired by the Crown Prince and Prime Minister at Gudaibiya Palace, the Cabinet strongly condemned the ongoing Iranian attacks on the kingdom and wished those injured a speedy recovery.

bahrain.title: Cityscape Bahrain opens in Sakhir, running until 28 November
bahrain.summary: The Crown Prince inaugurated the fifth Cityscape Bahrain, the kingdom's largest real estate exhibition, at Exhibition World Bahrain. It brings regional and international investors together with homebuyers and runs until 28 November.

bahrain.title: BBK offers 5% cashback on mortgages of up to BD 750,000 at Cityscape
bahrain.summary: BBK, the exhibition's official banking partner for a third year, is offering 5% cashback on home financing taken out during Cityscape, with loans up to BD 750,000, instant approvals and terms of up to 30 years. The offer runs until Saturday.

bahrain.title: Bahrain climbs to 14th in UN e-government survey, plans digital push
bahrain.summary: Bahrain rose four places to 14th in the UN E-Government Survey 2026. Officials at the Information and eGovernment Authority said they will build on the result with a drive to improve digital literacy and develop human capital, and the Cabinet praised the ranking.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Development Bank launches BDB Plus services package for SMEs
bahrain.summary: BDB Plus gives small and medium firms discounted non-financial services from partners, including business communications and hardware from Batelco and point-of-sale systems from EazyPay, aiming to cut setup costs for smaller businesses.

bahrain.title: Women's business support portfolio has reached 10,686 beneficiaries
bahrain.summary: The Princess Sabeeka portfolio for supporting women's business activity, launched in 2010 with BD 1 million in capital, had helped 10,686 women by September 2026 with financing to start, grow and expand small and micro enterprises.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Bourse partners with local firm to bring agentic AI to the market
bahrain.summary: Bahrain Bourse signed a strategic agreement with Bahraini AI company Infiniteware to explore AI agent tools for market intelligence, analytics, automation, stakeholder engagement and internal operations across the capital market.

bahrain.title: Nationwide survey launched to measure ESG maturity of organisations
bahrain.summary: The Bahrain CSR Society and KPMG launched a kingdom-wide survey of public and private bodies to set a national baseline on how sustainability is built into operations, as regulatory requirements on environmental, social and governance reporting tighten.

crypto.title: US moves to permanently seize $1.1 billion stolen in Binance hack
crypto.summary: Prosecutors asked a Washington court to forfeit over $1.1 billion in USDC linked to the October hack of Binance, blamed on North Korea's TraderTraitor group. About $3 billion of the $6 billion plus taken has been frozen, seized or returned, while Elliptic says $247 million has gone through Bitcoin mixers.

crypto.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows hit a record $4.71 billion for November
crypto.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $569.7 million on Monday, a fifth straight day of withdrawals, taking November's outflows to $4.71 billion and past June's record of $4.51 billion. BlackRock's IBIT led with $1.95 billion out over five sessions.

crypto.title: Bitcoin slips back below $60,000 on new US tariff fears
crypto.summary: Bitcoin fell under $59,500 on Tuesday, nearly 8% below Monday's $64,500 high, as reports of planned US tariff increases hit stocks and erased the rally on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Markets also expect a 25 basis point Fed hike at the 8 to 9 December meeting.

crypto.title: South Korea drafts bill for bank-led stablecoins and lifting ICO ban
crypto.summary: The FSC's draft bill would limit won stablecoins to issuers majority-owned by banks, with 100% reserves and at least 5 billion won (about $3.7 million) in capital. It caps exchange shareholder stakes at 20%, or 34% with approval, and would end the 2017 ban on domestic ICOs.

crypto.title: BlackRock launches stablecoin-funded tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong
crypto.summary: BlackRock's HKD Digital Liquidity Fund opened with about $100 million, seeded by Standard Chartered and Ant International. Professional investors can subscribe and redeem with the HKDAP stablecoin, and the fund showed a 2.03% seven-day yield.

crypto.title: CFTC staff let exchanges count Bitcoin and Ether toward operating reserves
crypto.summary: Staff guidance says CFTC-regulated exchanges and clearinghouses may count Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins toward the 12 months of operating costs they must hold, with haircuts of at least 20% for BTC and ETH and 2% for stablecoins. It is not a formal rule.
